title: Sample Preparation with Custom Labware
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load deck with custom labware
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the OT‑2 deck as shown: Slot 1 – Custom 200 µL extended‑length tips; Slot 2 – Opentrons 1000 µL filter tips; Slot 3 – Corning 96‑well plate (360 µL); Slots 4‑6 – empty; Slot 7 – Opentrons 6‑tube rack with a 50 mL Falcon tube (A1: 30 mL water); Slot 8 – Custom Charles River tube rack (A1: 4 mL Sample 1; A2‑A4 and B1‑B4 empty); Slot 9 – empty; Slot 10 – Opentrons 24‑tube rack (as listed).

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, input any required protocol parameters as prompted.

steps.title: Download zipped protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Click the provided link to download the zipped protocol bundle containing the protocol file and a labware folder.

steps.title: Unzip protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Extract the downloaded zip file; verify that it contains a protocol file and a labware folder.

steps.title: Upload labware definition files
steps.instruction: Drag the labware definition files from the extracted labware folder into the ‘Custom Labware’ section of the ‘More’ tab in the OT App.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the extracted protocol file into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck per deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as described in the deck map (see Step 1) to ensure correct labware placement.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all loaded labware, tip racks, and the pipette(s). Refer to the support articles for calibration tip usage if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the protocol execution.
